## Hypothesis

We are trying to capture edge by optimizing exit parameters (take profit, stop loss, time stop, profit-lock arm) and trigger parameters (strike offset, volume ratio threshold) in the HTF-gated directional scoring framework (shotgun_scalper_stage4). The edge exists because default parameters may misalign with the optimal risk-reward profile for capturing short-term directional moves in SPY 0DTE options, particularly regarding profit-taking timing and stop placement relative to intraday volatility.

## Mechanism

**Entry:** HTF-gated directional scoring trigger (as defined in shotgun_scalper_stage4) fires when:
- Higher-timeframe trend aligns with intraday signal
- Strike offset = 2 (ITM-2 put/call)
- Volume ratio ≥ 1.2 (current bar volume vs. 20-bar average)

**Exit:** 
- Take profit at +75% premium gain (`tp_premium_pct=0.75`)
- Stop loss at -35% premium loss (`stop_premium_pct=-0.35`)
- Time stop at 12 minutes (`time_stop_min=12`)
- Profit-lock arms at +60% of entry premium (`chandelier_arm_pct=0.6`), then trails at 15% of high-water mark (implied by chandelier logic)
